title: Pass0bSegmentation
description: Identifies pedagogical arc segments within a Feldenkrais lesson for separate condensed synthesis.

segments.description: Contiguous segments of the lesson, each representing a distinct pedagogical arc. Most lessons have exactly one segment.

groups.description: Group numbers belonging to this segment, in order

theme.description: Brief phrase capturing the organizing principle of this segment

transition_note.description: What shifts at the boundary to the next segment. Null for the last segment.
